title: Exceptional coefficient construction: refinement mates
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ with $k=\overline{k_0}$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite extensions $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation rings $R_E$, uniformizers $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=R_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism; neither $X$ nor $Y$ is assumed separated over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow{p_c}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $d=(X\xrightarrow{j_d}\overline X_d\xrightarrow{p_d}Y)$ be a second compactification and $u:c\to d$ a proper refinement. For each finite stage use the exact constructible adjunction $F^c_A\dashv G^c_A$ transported from the ordinary etale compact-support adjunction. At integral stages use its actual normalized-system reduction/limit transport with prescribed compact-support realization $r_{c,R}$; at rational stages use raw localization; at an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ use common finite fields [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. All units, counits and shift structures are those of these transported adjunctions. Then at every stage $s$ there are shift-compatible natural isomorphisms
$$\alpha_{u,s}:F^c_s\xrightarrow{\sim}F^d_s,\qquad\rho_{u,s}:G^d_s\xrightarrow{\sim}G^c_s$$
satisfying both equations
$$\epsilon^d_L\circ\alpha_{u,s,G^d_sL}=\epsilon^c_L\circ F^c_s(\rho_{u,s,L}),\qquad
\rho_{u,s,F^d_sK}\circ\eta^d_K=G^c_s(\alpha_{u,s,K})\circ\eta^c_K.$$
At finite stages $\alpha$ is exactly the open-unit-normalized inverse of $j_{d!}\cong Ru_*j_{c!}$ followed by proper direct-image composition, under the canonical site comparisons. At integral stages it is the actual total-limit realization of that system map; under $r_{c,R},r_{d,R}$ it is the same ambient proper/open refinement comparison, with matching termwise and Roos-cone shifts. This equality holds for actual system maps before total limit. The right map is the transpose of $\epsilon^d\circ\alpha_{G^d}$, with inverse the corresponding transpose of $\alpha^{-1}$.

At rational stages $\alpha,\rho$ are the localized integral maps on the same representatives. At the closed stage they are their common-field images. If $J_E$ is a common-field inclusion and $q^c,q^d$ its compact-support comparisons, then
$$\alpha_{u,\Omega,J_EK}=q^d_K\circ J_E(\alpha_{u,E,K})\circ(q^c_K)^{-1}.$$
The refinement equations and shift compatibility refer throughout to these same choices, with no new adjunction or compact-support representative.

proof.text: Obtain only the normalized left family N from exceptional_refinement_left_construction. Complete its stagewise left isomorphism to a RefinementComparison using the existing proved refinementComparisonOfLeft. Its construction gives both adjunction equations and the right shift square. The conjugate isomorphism and its inverse have exactly the two stated Hom transposes.

Prove coefficient descent of any two counit-normalized right comparisons from the left square. Cancel the source right coefficient isomorphism and apply injectivity of the inverse Hom equivalence. Its two transposes are equal: use the two coefficient counit equations, naturality of q inverse, the refinement counit equation and the left coefficient square, then naturality of the target left comparison. Apply this calculation to localization and to each common-field inclusion; the left squares are precisely N.rational and N.common. The remaining normalization and left descent fields are N fields verbatim.
For the resulting Mates P apply exceptional_refinement_system_realization separately at every field E with the supplied o(E),R(E). Pair P with these Nonempty realization conclusions.
